g.text: GDHUB-74 — the curator's fee, the monthly payout, running cost and margin
A fee is earned (one CheckpointFee row per checkpoint × curator, frozen)
Running cost per checkpoint (11.5 margin line, 13.1 tooltip)

text.tspan: Human checkpoint leaves running:
• Closed with the curator's own verdict (decidedById = curatorId)
• Cancelled by refund 'withdrawal' (§3.3: calls held so far)
• curatorDeclined / checkpointCancelled before any call → nothing
Nothing for a curator who stopped (§3.4):
refund 'curatorGone' · 'noVerdict' · admin's verdict ·
the curator an admin replaced (AuditLog curatorAssigned.fromCuratorId)
their parts = calls they joined + the verdict if they sent it
(replacement: calls from AuditLog.fromSession onwards + verdict;
CHECKPOINT_PARTS.Human = 6)
fee = floor(Payment.amount × their parts / 6 × (1 − PLATFORM_SHARE 0.30))
= 70% of what the author keeps paying for their parts
(promo code already in Payment.amount; refund already excluded by parts)
reason: full · refundReduced · replacement
earnedAt = decidedAt or the refund's time → the month it belongs to (UTC)
upsert CheckpointFee {checkpointId, curatorId} — idempotent;
written in afterVerdictSent and after issueCheckpointRefund('withdrawal')
month M (default: last month)
rows = CheckpointFee earnedAt in M, grouped by curator
Due: no CuratorPayout {curatorId, M}
Late: Due and today > 15th of M+1 (PAYOUT_DUE_DAY)
Paid: CuratorPayout exists
ExpertProfile payoutHolder / payoutAccount / invoicing
missing → Mark paid disabled
POST /api/admin/payouts {curatorId, month, paidOn, reference}
Payout = sum of the month's unpaid fees, read on the server, not sent by the client
one transaction: CuratorPayout row · CheckpointFee.payoutId · AuditLog
unique (curatorId, month) → a second click is refused

g.text: Add a note (13.3c): PATCH note only — amount, date, reference never change

text.tspan: own CheckpointFee rows (where curatorId = me)
Earned (month not over) · Due on 15th · Paid on date · No fee (stopped)

g.text: earned this month · due next · paid total

text.tspan: calls = Σ participantMinutes × DAILY_VIDEO_RATE
+ Σ (endedAt − curatorJoinedAt) min × (RECORDING_RATE + TRANSCRIPT_RATE)
AI = Σ CheckpointAiUsage.cost
cost frozen at the call: input × in-price + output × out-price
(per model, per million tokens, AI_MODEL_PRICES in config)
every AI call for a checkpoint records {checkpointId, purpose, model, inputTokens, outputTokens, cost}:
AI curator (checkGoal, reviews, verdict) · call notes · devlog reviews · task advice
fire-and-forget: a failed log never fails the AI call
margin = paid − refunded − fees − calls − AI
card counts Closed checkpoints only; Stripe fee not counted
